HR Policy & Guidelines Document
Prepared for RAG Testing Purposes

Introduction
This HR manual contains detailed policies and procedures to ensure smooth operations,
compliance, and employee satisfaction. It is structured into sections for easy navigation and
retrieval. This document is also designed to be used in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
testing scenarios.

Leave Policy
Employees are entitled to 20 paid leaves annually. Sick leaves must be accompanied by a medical
certificate. Casual leave can be applied through the HR portal. Any absence without intimation
beyond 3 days will be treated as leave without pay. Special leaves such as maternity, paternity, or
bereavement are governed by separate rules.

Working Hours & Attendance
The standard working hours are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Employees are
expected to log a minimum of 8 hours daily. Biometric systems are used to track attendance.
Work-from-home is permissible with prior approval. Flexible work schedules may be implemented in
specific projects.

Code of Conduct
All employees must follow company values, professional ethics, and integrity standards.
Harassment, discrimination, or misconduct is strictly prohibited. Confidential company data should
not be shared externally. Conflicts of interest must be disclosed to HR.

Performance Management
Performance reviews will be conducted twice a year. Employees will be evaluated on the basis of
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), peer feedback, and manager evaluations. Promotions and
salary hikes are performance-driven. Training programs will be arranged to help employees
improve skills.

Payroll & Benefits
Salaries are credited on the last working day of every month. Benefits include health insurance,
provident fund, gratuity, and annual bonuses based on performance. Tax declarations must be
submitted on time to avoid deduction discrepancies.

Employee Grievances
Employees may raise grievances regarding workplace issues, harassment, or policy violations
through the HR portal. Complaints will be addressed confidentially and fairly by the Internal
Complaints Committee (ICC).

Training & Development
The company invests in continuous learning programs. Workshops, online certifications, and
leadership development courses are provided. Employees are encouraged to enroll in at least one
training session every quarter.

Exit Policy
Employees resigning must serve a notice period of 60 days. Exit interviews are conducted to
understand reasons for leaving and gather feedback. Full & final settlements are processed within
45 days after clearance from all departments.
